integrity: All listed standalone artifacts are fully included, with no external computational dependencies beyond the Python 3 standard library. The analytic proof, not finite testing, establishes the all-parameter assertions.
scientific_limitations: Sharp global lower bound applies to radial disks in rotational cones of total angle at most 2π and fixed intrinsic area, not to arbitrary cone-surfaces.
Angles above 2π are abstract metric cones and need not embed as right circular cones in Euclidean three-space.
The evaluated statistic is the intrinsic squared geodesic distance of two independently area-uniform points; no all-moment optimization is claimed.
Theoretical proof and same-model review are not independent mathematical validation; historical novelty remains subject to independent checking.
title: Sharp mean-square geodesic separation and a third-order transition in Euclidean cone disks
